questions: Should the strings be sorted lexicographically (dictionary order) or by some other criterion like length?
Is the sorting order ascending or descending?
Should the sorting be case-sensitive? (All strings are lowercase, but if input validation fails, could uppercase appear?)
Are duplicate strings allowed? The constraints only mention different lengths, not different content.
Should the concatenation include any separators between the sorted strings?
Is the output expected to be a single line without any newlines, or can it span multiple lines?
If two strings have the same prefix but different lengths, how should they be ordered relative to each other?
Should the sorting be done based on the entire string or some transformed version (e.g., reversed)?
